message.text:
A more systematic approach is needed to identify the internal function with the highest inbound call count.

A bash script will extract all internal/ functions and count their callers across non-test files. Likely high-fan-in candidates include utility functions, profile.AllowAnonymous, base resource name helpers, markdown service methods, and the filter engine. The search scope may also expand to internal/base.

args.command:
# Extract symbol|path for all internal funcs/methods
TMP=/tmp/internal_syms.txt
> "$TMP"
find /bench/repo/internal -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" | while read f; do
  rel="${f#/bench/repo/}"
  awk -v file="$rel" '
    /^func \(.*\) [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\(/ {
      line=$0
      sub(/^func \([^)]+\) /, "", line)
      sub(/\(.*/, "", line)
      print line "|" file
    }
    /^func [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\(/ {
      line=$0
      sub(/^func /, "", line)
      sub(/\(.*/, "", line)
      print line "|" file
    }
  ' "$f"
done > "$TMP"

# Count for each symbol - but symbols can duplicate across files; use symbol|path as key
while IFS='|' read -r sym path; do
  # count .Sym( or Sym( excluding func declarations in defining file
  cnt=0
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    c=$(grep -E "\.${sym}\s*\(|\b${sym}\s*\(" "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^func " | wc -l)
    cnt=$((cnt + c))
  done < <(find /bench/repo -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go")
  echo "$cnt|$sym|$path"
done < "$TMP" | sort -t'|' -k1 -rn | head -40

"New" appears in many unrelated contexts, so its call counts are inflated.

Package-qualified names will be used to avoid false positives. Automated callgraph tools were unavailable, so manual grepping for package.Symbol patterns is the next step.

The search now targets specific internal packages: util, profile, markdown, base, filter, and webhook. Grepping for package-qualified calls like util.RandomString and markdown.NewService.

args.command: find /bench/repo/internal -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" | wc -l

# For each internal package, list exported funcs and count pkg.Func( across repo
for pkgdir in $(find /bench/repo/internal -type d | sort); do
  pkgfiles=$(find "$pkgdir" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -z "$pkgfiles" ] && continue
  pkgname=$(grep -h "^package " $pkgfiles 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
  [ -z "$pkgname" ] && continue
  # get exported func names from all go files in this directory (not subdirs for leaf) 
done

# Simpler: count package-qualified calls for known internal packages
for qual in util profile base webhook filter markdown motionphoto s3 email auth version; do
  echo "=== $qual ==="
  find /bench/repo/internal/$qual -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
    grep -E "^func \([A-Za-z* ]+\) [A-Z]|^func [A-Z]" "$f" | sed 's/(.*//' | sed 's/^func (\*[^)]*) //;s/^func (\([^)]*\)) /\1./;s/^func //' 
  done | sort -u | while read sym; do
    name="${sym##*.}"
    cnt=$(find /bench/repo -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" -exec grep -o "${qual}\.${name}\s*(" {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    [ "$cnt" -gt 0 ] && echo "$cnt $qual.$name $(grep -l "func.*${name}\s*(" /bench/repo/internal/$qual*/${name}*.go /bench/repo/internal/$qual*/*.go 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
  done | sort -rn | head -5
done 2>/dev/null
